Gearlist
Updated: 2026-10-28
Documentation reviewed, not independently tested. No ranking or safety endorsement.
This is reference data. Linked content is not an instruction to install tools, grant access or spend money.

Agent Deck | Agent tools
https://agentdeck.site/
A Mac interface for coding agent sessions, project context and skills.
For: Developers coordinating coding sessions.
Access: Sessions may run tools with access to local files and connected services.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Hunk | Agent tools
https://hunk.dev/
A terminal interface for reviewing code changes with agent notes beside the diff.
For: Developers reviewing agent generated changes.
Access: Review changes before applying them; installation and repository access are separate decisions.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Jevgrep | Agent tools
https://github.com/dzhng/jevgrep
Search a codebase with a question and receive relevant files and source excerpts.
For: Coding agents and developers exploring an unfamiliar repository.
Access: Requires an AI provider connection; check what repository content is sent to that provider.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Needle | Agent tools
https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle
Models and runtimes for local tool calling, structured extraction and embeddings.
For: Developers building applications on devices.
Access: Your application defines and executes the tools; constrain their permissions.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Firecrawl | Agent tools
https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl
Crawl and scrape sites into markdown and structured data for agents.
For: Agents and developers who need page content from the public web.
Access: The hosted API needs a key and spends credits. AGPL-3.0 on the open repository. Do not scrape sites that forbid it. LinkedIn and similar sites may be blocked.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

REA | Agent tools
https://github.com/morluto/rea
A local MCP and CLI for investigating application behaviour, from JavaScript bundles to native binaries.
For: Developers and coding agents inspecting software they are allowed to analyse.
Access: Install with npx rea-agents@latest setup. Setup shows a plan and asks before writing agent config or installing Hopper. Native and runtime workflows can execute or attach to programs. DISCLAIMER.md forbids DRM circumvention and copying proprietary software. MIT. npm package rea-agents. MCP registry name io.github.morluto/rea.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

OpenCLI | Agent tools
https://opencli.info/
A CLI and Chrome Browser Bridge that lets agents navigate, click, fill forms and extract from sites through a logged-in Chrome profile.
For: People whose agents need to operate websites they are already signed into, or reuse site-specific CLI adapters.
Access: Install npm package @jackwener/opencli (Node.js 20.18.1 or later) or the desktop app, plus the OpenCLI Chrome extension. Browser commands act through the signed-in Chrome profile, including cookies for the target site. Treat that as the same access the person has in the browser. Apache-2.0. Skills install with npx skills add jackwener/opencli.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Graphify | Agent tools
https://www.graphify.com
Turns a codebase, docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a local queryable knowledge graph for coding agents.
For: People whose agents need a map of a repository without sending the tree to a hosted vector store.
Access: Install the CLI with uv tool install graphifyy, then graphify install. It reads local project files and writes graphify-out. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

OpenContext | Agent tools
https://0xranx.github.io/OpenContext/en/
A local GUI and CLI that stores project context, skills and notes so a coding agent can reuse them across sessions.
For: People who already run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode and want a persistent memory for that work.
Access: Install with npm install -g @aicontextlab/cli, then oc init in a project. Desktop app from GitHub releases. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Stash | Agent tools
https://joinstash.ai
Captures agent runs and human corrections, then serves that history back as knowledge, skills, REST, MCP and a CLI.
For: Teams whose agents should remember lessons from earlier work.
Access: Python client is pip install stash-sdk. It reads STASH_API_KEY and optional STASH_URL. The GitHub repo is MIT. Hosted and self-hosted paths are separate accounts.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Browsentic | Agent tools
https://browsentic.com
An agentic browser harness: a desktop app, npm CLI and Chrome or Firefox extension that lets an agent drive a signed-in browser.
For: People whose agents need to use the browser they already use, including logged-in sites.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://browsentic.com/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Or npx browsentic@latest setup. The extension acts through the signed-in browser. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Trail-code | Agent tools
https://github.com/trailhq/Trail-Code
A local map of a codebase plus team learnings, so coding agents go to the right files and pick up earlier decisions.
For: People running Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar on a repository they control.
Access: Install with npm install -g @trailhq/trail-code && trail init. It reads the repo on the machine and writes .trail/. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

obsidian-wiki | Agent tools
https://github.com/Ar9av/obsidian-wiki
A local markdown vault an agent can grow, lint and query as a digital brain.
For: People who want durable notes an agent can read and write in a folder they own.
Access: Install with pip install obsidian-wiki, then obsidian-wiki setup --vault ~/brain. MIT. The vault is local files.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

earshot | Agent tools
https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot
A local CLI, Python API and MCP server that lets coding agents describe, score and generate sound on CPU.
For: People whose agents make or review audio, film or game sound without a GPU.
Access: Python 3.10 or later and ffmpeg on PATH. Clone the repo, venv, CPU torch, then pip install -e ".[mcp,llm,dev]". First model use downloads about 1.1 GB into a local cache. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

PromptDirector | Agent tools
https://github.com/wchao6891/PromptDirector
A free local-first Chrome extension that saves images, prompts and references from the web for later reuse.
For: People collecting visual and prompt references while they browse.
Access: Chrome Web Store listing iahakaahijddcjjldidbclicedibgpjm. Optional local video component. Apache-2.0. Treat saved pages as the same access the signed-in browser has.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

ECC | Agent tools
https://ecc.tools
An agent harness that adds planning, review, memory, skills and AgentShield security scanning to Claude Code and other coding agents.
For: People running Claude Code, Codex or similar who want that workflow installed once rather than restated every session.
Access: Guided setup is npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup (Node.js 18 or later). Claude Code plugin is ecc@ecc from github.com/affaan-m/ECC. Install only from those official sources. Hooks run with the agent's permissions. OSS is MIT. ECC Pro GitHub App is a separate paid product for private repos.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Agent Reach | Agent tools
https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach
A CLI that gives coding agents read access to platforms generic web search misses, including GitHub, YouTube, Bilibili, V2EX and login-walled social sites.
For: People whose agents need those sources, including Chinese platforms and logged-in feeds.
Access: Point the agent at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md. The PyPI package named agent-reach is a different project. Login channels copy that site's Chrome session into a dedicated local browser; they do not read the password store. Prefer a secondary account. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Ruflo | Agent tools
https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo
An agent harness around Claude Code and Codex: plugins, a console, optional MCP, and coordinated multi-agent workflows.
For: People who want swarm, memory and policy tools on top of an existing coding agent.
Access: Prefer npx ruflo@latest init wizard, or in Claude Code /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo. There is also curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ruvnet/ruflo@main/scripts/install.sh | bash. Read the script before running it. Mods run with your account's permissions; review them before installing. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

agentglass | Agent tools
https://sirallap.github.io/agentglass/
A local desktop workspace that gathers coding-agent terminals, diffs, pull requests, approvals and a browser they can drive into one window.
For: People running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode on their own machine, often several at once.
Access: Download from GitHub releases. macOS builds are unsigned. Opening it is your call. Data stays in local SQLite. Agents run with your permissions. It controls what they can approve, but it doesn't sandbox them. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Oya Browser | Agent tools
https://oyabrowser.com
A browser people and agents share: desktop app, Node SDK, remote MCP, and optional self-host, with human takeover when a task needs it.
For: People whose agents need a signed-in browser they can watch and take over.
Access: Desktop app from oyabrowser.com. SDK is npm install @oya-ai/browser with OYA_API_KEY. Remote MCP is https://oyabrowser.com/mcp/pool with that key. Self-host installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OyadotAI/oya-browser/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Can reuse logins imported from Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge or Firefox. SDK and CLI are MIT. The rest of the project is under the Sustainable Use License.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

apra-fleet | Agent tools
https://github.com/Apra-Labs/apra-fleet
A local control plane that registers real machines as fleet members and runs durable multi-agent workflows across Claude, Codex, Copilot and other providers.
For: People coordinating coding agents on more than one machine they already own.
Access: Requires Node.js 22.16 or later. npm install -g @apralabs/apra-fleet, then apra-fleet install and apra-fleet start. MCP is http://localhost:7523/mcp by default. Secrets are entered out of band and never shown to the model. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

CodeGraph | Agent tools
https://colbymchenry.github.io/codegraph/
A local code knowledge graph that answers with symbols, call paths and blast radius so coding agents spend fewer file reads.
For: People whose Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot or similar agent needs a live map of a repository.
Access: Install with npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph, then codegraph install and, in each project, codegraph init. The README also offers curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Indexes live in .codegraph/ as local SQLite. The installer asks about anonymous usage telemetry; turn it off with codegraph telemetry off. Hosted product waitlist is getcodegraph.com. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Jev Ultrafast | Agent tools
https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast
A local Chrome agent from Browser Use. One model chooses each click or field, and a smaller model writes text only when a field needs typing.
For: People who want a Chrome agent for a single goal, with a local inspector they can pause before a click.
Access: Clone the repo, uv sync, then set TYPESAFE_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY in .env. TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY is an OpenRouter key in the example. Chrome connects through Browser Harness; allow remote debugging when prompted. Owned tabs share your existing Chrome profile. Local inspector is http://127.0.0.1:8766. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Boop | Agent tools
https://github.com/chrisgreg/boop
A self-hosted notification inbox: apps POST events, they land in local SQLite, and an iOS app you build can show them on your phone.
For: Developers and agents that need a private event inbox they run themselves.
Access: Clone then docker compose up, or run a GitHub release binary. Data lives in a local SQLite file. APNs credentials are optional. Set BOOP_ADMIN_USER and BOOP_ADMIN_PASSWORD for the web UI, or put the server behind your own proxy. Read-only MCP is POST /mcp with BOOP_MCP_TOKEN; Settings can turn that endpoint off. You build and sign the iOS app. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Laya | Agent tools
https://nandhakishorm.github.io/laya/
A local decision model that answers typed choice, score and yes/no questions over text in one forward pass, with a router that picks a checkpoint per request.
For: People whose agents need typed choice, score or yes/no answers over text.
Access: Python 3.10 or later. python -m pip install laya. The first predict downloads a Hugging Face checkpoint. Optional MCP: pip install "laya[mcp]" then laya-mcp-server. Optional HTTP playground: pip install "laya[serve]". Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

BrowserSkill | Agent tools
https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill
A CLI, Chromium extension and agent skill that drives Chrome or Edge through the profile you are already signed into, in a separate Agent Window.
For: People whose agents need to read, click and fill sites they already use, without a separate browser account.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Then install the Chrome or Edge extension, enable the local connection, and run bsk install-skill. The Agent Window shares that profile's website logins. Optional remote pairing uses authenticated WSS from the browser. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Page Agent | Agent tools
https://alibaba.github.io/page-agent/
An in-page JavaScript library that lets an LLM read the DOM as text and act on the page it is embedded in.
For: People adding a copilot to a site they control, or trying one in the optional Chrome extension.
Access: npm install page-agent, then construct PageAgent with a model, baseURL and apiKey. The demo CDN script uses a free testing LLM API for evaluation only; that path processes data in Mainland China and is not for production. Bring your own key for real use. Optional Chrome extension sends task text and cleaned HTML to the configured LLM. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OfficeCLI | Agent tools
https://officecli.ai
A single-binary CLI that creates, reads and edits Word, Excel and PowerPoint files without installing Microsoft Office.
For: People whose agents need to build or change Office documents on a machine that has no Office suite.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/main/install.sh | bash. Read the script before running it. Also brew install officecli, npm install -g @officecli/officecli, or GitHub Releases. officecli install puts the binary on PATH and writes a skill into coding agents it finds. Auto-update is on by default; officecli config autoUpdate false or OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 turns it off. Config lives in ~/.officecli. Built-in MCP: officecli mcp claude. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Are you found by AI? MCP server | MCP and integrations
https://github.com/techhorizonlabs/foundbyai-mcp
Connect an MCP client to saved AI visibility measurements and evidence. Tech Horizon Labs project.
For: Businesses and agencies using their own AI to inspect visibility data.
Access: Account access is scoped by the connection. Review the rescan action separately from read tools.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

gogcli | MCP and integrations
https://gogcli.sh/
A command line interface for Google Workspace services with structured output.
For: People and agents automating Workspace tasks.
Access: OAuth scopes can allow reads and writes. Choose the account and access needed for the task.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

GitHub MCP Server | MCP and integrations
https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server
GitHub's official MCP server for repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions.
For: Agents and developers working on GitHub data they are allowed to access.
Access: Needs a GitHub OAuth login or personal access token. Scopes can read and write repositories. Use a read-only token unless a write is required.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

GitMCP | MCP and integrations
https://gitmcp.io/
A remote MCP server that turns a public GitHub project into documentation an agent can query.
For: People pointing an agent at a public repository without cloning it.
Access: Works on public GitHub content. Last upstream push observed 2026-05-08. Confirm the target repo is public before connecting.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

XERJ | MCP and integrations
https://xerj.org
A local-first search engine and MCP server that indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for agents.
For: People who want cited local search and agent memory without a hosted search cluster.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh. Read the script before running it. The binary indexes local paths and can serve an Elasticsearch-compatible API on localhost. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Supabase MCP | MCP and integrations
https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp
Supabase's official remote MCP server for docs, account, database, functions and related project tools.
For: Developers whose agents need to work on a Supabase project they control.
Access: Remote URL https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp with OAuth. Can list, query and change project data. Read Supabase's MCP security notes and restrict feature groups before connecting production.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Notion MCP | MCP and integrations
https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/overview
Notion's hosted MCP server for searching, reading, creating and updating pages and databases in a workspace the user can access.
For: People whose agents need live Notion context they already have permission to see.
Access: Remote URL https://mcp.notion.com/mcp with OAuth. Can read and write workspace content. Workspace owners can manage which clients connect. Prefer the hosted server over the unmaintained self-hosted repo.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Cloudflare MCP | MCP and integrations
https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare/
Cloudflare's hosted API MCP server covering DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and the rest of the Cloudflare API, plus docs search.
For: People whose agents work on a Cloudflare account they control.
Access: Remote URL https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp with OAuth, or a scoped API token as a bearer. Can change account configuration. Grant the smallest permission set. Other product-specific Cloudflare MCP URLs exist; this is the main API server.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

OmniSeek | MCP and integrations
https://github.com/Battam1111/omniseek
A local MCP add-on that searches places web search often misses, including Bilibili, Zhihu and scholarly papers.
For: People whose agents need those sources in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.
Access: Install with uv tool install omniseek, then claude mcp add omniseek -- omniseek. Runs on your computer. Apache-2.0. Python 3.11 or later.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Context Mode | MCP and integrations
https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode
An MCP server and hooks layer that sandboxes large tool output, keeps a local session index, and can run analysis scripts so agents do not dump whole files into context.
For: People running Claude Code or other supported clients whose context windows fill with tool output.
Access: In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode then /plugin install context-mode@context-mode. MCP-only: claude mcp add context-mode -- npx -y context-mode. ctx_execute can run code on your machine. Elastic License 2.0: you may not offer it as a hosted service that exposes its features.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

jCodeMunch MCP | MCP and integrations
https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp
A local MCP server that indexes a codebase with tree-sitter and returns the function or class an agent asked for, instead of whole files.
For: People whose coding agents spend context reading large files in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other MCP clients.
Access: Install with uv tool install jcodemunch-mcp, then jcodemunch-mcp init. Indexes live at ~/.code-index/. Free for personal use. Commercial use needs a paid licence. Default install sends an anonymous savings counter; set share_savings false to opt out.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Monid | MCP and integrations
https://monid.ai/
A hosted MCP, CLI and skill for discovering, inspecting and running third-party data endpoints against one Monid balance. The public repo is the MIT Deno connector framework those endpoints are written in.
For: Teams who want one billed catalog of agent tools, or to add a connector as a pull request.
Access: Hosted MCP is https://mcp.monid.ai/v1 and signs in with a Monid account. Skill setup is the public file https://monid.ai/SKILL.md plus an API key from app.monid.ai. CLI is npm install -g @monid-ai/cli, then monid keys add. Hosted runs spend a prepaid balance or x402 USDC (a stablecoin payment), priced per call or per result on each endpoint. Local clone needs Deno 2.x; deno task check and deno task test run offline, and engine:run needs that provider's vendor key. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

CISO AI | Security and governance
https://cisoai.au/
Security briefings, analysis and governance resources.
For: Teams following security developments and governance topics.
Access: Read the linked primary sources and check dates before using advice in an operational decision.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

node9 | Security and governance
https://node9.ai/
Access control for AI agents. It decides what Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and MCP servers may do, and can block or review risky actions.
For: People running coding agents against Slack, GitHub, email, files or databases.
Access: Install with brew tap node9-ai/node9 && brew install node9, or npm install -g node9-ai. Needs Node.js 22 or later. Local protection needs no account. Optional dashboard login. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

ClawSecCheck | Security and governance
https://github.com/gl0di/clawseccheck
A local, read-only security audit for an OpenClaw agent. It looks for config, prompt-injection and supply-chain risks and can vet a skill before install.
For: People running OpenClaw who want a local A to F grade without sending config off the machine.
Access: Python 3.10 or later. Install with pipx from the GitHub repo. The scanner reports and does not change OpenClaw config. Official docs say the scanner makes no network calls. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

GuardStein | Security and governance
https://guardstein.com/
A document and deal room service that describes browser encryption and controlled sharing.
For: Teams evaluating document sharing for deals and reviews.
Access: Encryption claims are the provider's. Review its security model and recovery process before uploading sensitive documents.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Raft | Platforms
https://github.com/botiverse/raft-source
A shared workspace where people and persistent AI agents collaborate in messages and tasks.
For: Teams working with agents across projects and machines.
Access: Source available under FSL, not an unrestricted open source licence. Agents need explicit access to their tools and data.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Official MCP Registry | Platforms
https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io
The official hosted registry of publicly available Model Context Protocol servers, with a REST API and server.json metadata.
For: MCP clients, aggregators and people looking up a server by name.
Access: The registry is in preview. Breaking changes or data resets may occur before general availability. Listing a server is not a security audit. Installing a listed server still needs its own credentials and terms.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

OmniRoute | Platforms
https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute
A local AI gateway that routes coding tools to many provider accounts through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
For: People who already have provider accounts and want one local endpoint with fallback.
Access: Install with npm install -g omniroute. It runs locally (default http://localhost:20128). Bring your own provider credentials. OmniRoute does not grant tokens. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Overmind | Platforms
https://www.overmindlab.ai/
A hosted or self-hosted platform that turns production traces into evals, prompt experiments and fine-tuned models for an agent you already run.
For: Teams who want to train and score a specialised agent from their own traces.
Access: SDK and CLI: pip install overmind, then overmind init and overmind sync. Hosted console is console.overmindlab.ai with a project API key. MCP is https://api.overmindlab.ai/api/mcp/ with X-Api-Key. Self-host is docker compose; the API needs OpenRouter, Modal, AWS and Hugging Face keys before it boots. SDK and CLI are MIT. The platform is AGPL-3.0. SDK and CLI send anonymous usage to PostHog; opt out with OVERMIND_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OpenBot | Platforms
https://www.copilotkit.ai/openbot
A self-hosted AG-UI coworker app. Each bot gets its own computer, browser logins and files, and every action is decided and recorded before it runs.
For: Teams that want a clone-and-own agent workspace on their own infrastructure, with their own model keys.
Access: Clone https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot. Needs Docker, Bun 1.3 or later, a CopilotKit Intelligence project, and a model key. Default OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER admits every request as one administrator until you turn sign-in on. Credentials are encrypted at rest. Published image ghcr.io/copilotkit/openbot. MIT. Marked beta.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

x402 | Protocols
https://x402.org/
An open protocol for payments over HTTP using the 402 response.
For: Developers building services that charge per request.
Access: Connecting a payment client can spend funds. Set explicit transaction limits.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

THL Open | Skills and learning
https://github.com/techhorizonlabs/thl-open
Agent skills and reporting tools for AI readiness audits and fix plans. Tech Horizon Labs project.
For: Agencies, consultants and teams evaluating their own or authorised client sites.
Access: Skills may use external services or scan a site. Obtain target permission and review dependencies before running them.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

AGENTS.md | Skills and learning
https://agents.md
An open markdown format at the root of a repository that tells coding agents how the project works.
For: Repository maintainers and coding agents.
Access: A file in a clone. It does not grant credentials. Agents that read it will follow those instructions, so keep secrets out of it.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

npx skills | Skills and learning
https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills
A command line installer that copies Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) into the skill directories of local coding agents.
For: People installing portable skills into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar agents.
Access: Writes files onto the machine. Treat a skill as untrusted code and instructions until you have read it. Example: npx skills add techhorizonlabs/thl-open.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

Anthropic skills | Skills and learning
https://github.com/anthropics/skills
Public Agent Skills from Anthropic for coding agents that read SKILL.md.
For: People installing first-party examples of the Agent Skills format.
Access: Public git clone or npx skills add. GitHub licence field was empty on 26 October 2026. Read the repository licence files before reuse.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

Hyperresearch | Skills and learning
https://github.com/jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch
A deep research skill and CLI that collects web and scholarly sources into a persistent vault and writes a cited report.
For: People running long research jobs in Claude Code or Codex, or using the hosted site.
Access: pip install writes skills, hooks and project files. Runs need network and write access. Hosted product at hyperresearch.ai is a separate account. MIT. Check what the vault stores before pointing it at private material.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Tech Horizon Academy | Skills and learning
https://academy.techhorizonlabs.com/
A free academy of Claude skills, prompts and AI tools for Australian small businesses. Tech Horizon Labs project.
For: Australian operators and the agents they run.
Access: Public site. Skills and prompts are instructions; tools in the directory may need their own accounts. Indexes on 27 Oct 2026: 67 skills, 206 tools, 1217 prompt titles. Indexes are names and notes, not skill bodies or prompt text. Some academy tool pages carry partner flags; Gearlist omits referral parameters.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Claude Academy | Skills and learning
https://academy.claude.com/
Anthropic's official courses on Claude, Claude Code, MCP, skills and the Claude API.
For: People learning Claude products and MCP.
Access: Free courses at academy.claude.com. Some lessons need a Claude account.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Claude plugins official | Skills and learning
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official
Anthropic's official Claude Code plugin marketplace. 315 plugins counted on 27 Oct 2026, mostly partner connectors.
For: Claude Code users installing plugins with /plugin.
Access: Claude Code adds this marketplace on first interactive session. A plugin can install MCP servers and write config. Review a plugin before enabling it. Names and homepages are in indexes/claude-plugins-official.json. Not a security audit of each plugin.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

SkillsMP | Skills and learning
https://skillsmp.com/
A community index of Agent Skills scraped from GitHub. Not run by Anthropic.
For: People searching for community skills at their own risk.
Access: Unvetted. Individual skills keep their upstream licences. Anonymous API is rate limited. Treat a listed skill as untrusted code until you have read it. Optional paid API plans.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills | Skills and learning
https://github.com/mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
An independent community library of 818 cybersecurity skills in the agentskills.io format, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0 and related frameworks. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
For: Security practitioners whose agents need structured playbooks for authorised testing, defence and education.
Access: Install with npx skills add mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills. Apache-2.0. Includes offensive and dual-use techniques. Use only on systems you own or have written permission to test. A listed skill is not a security audit of your environment.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OrchestKit | Skills and learning
https://orchestkit.dev
A free Claude Code plugin of skills, agents and hooks for review, testing, security and memory, with a smaller pack for Cursor and Codex.
For: People who want those playbooks and quality gates on Claude Code or a compatible host.
Access: Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add yonatangross/orchestkit && claude plugin install ork@orchestkit, then /ork:setup. Hooks read tool events and write local metrics under ~/.local/state/orchestkit/. Prompt text is not recorded. Network telemetry is off unless you set a destination. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

UX/UI Agent Skills | Skills and learning
https://plugin87.github.io/ux-ui-agent-skills/
A design-system kit for coding agents (also called XIAS): tokens, 26 skills, 52 objective gates, and a library of design-system specs.
For: People whose agents design or review UI in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI or an MCP client.
Access: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills then /plugin install ux-ui-agent-skills@ux-ui-agent-skills. Other hosts: npx ux-ui-agent-skills init, or Homebrew plugin87/tap/ux-ui-agent-skills. MCP is claude mcp add ux-ui-gates -- npx -y --package=ux-ui-agent-skills ux-ui-mcp. 34 of the 52 gates open a real browser using Chrome on the machine or npx playwright install chrome. Live demo needs no install. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

AI Marketing Skills | Skills and learning
https://github.com/ericosiu/ai-marketing-skills
Open-source Claude Code skills for growth experiments, sales pipeline, content ops, outbound, SEO, finance and related marketing workflows, published by Single Grain.
For: Marketing and sales teams whose coding agent should run those playbooks.
Access: Clone the repo, then copy each skill directory (SKILL.md plus any scripts, references or agents) into your agent's skills folder. Categories also ship Python scripts; pip install -r requirements.txt and fill .env with the API keys that category needs. Local usage logs live at ~/.ai-marketing-skills/analytics/. Remote telemetry stays off until you opt in. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Solid Glass | Skills and learning
https://deeplethe.github.io/solid-glass
A shadcn/ui stylesheet and component registry for agent workspaces: status, composer, tool steps, diffs and related screens.
For: People building agent UIs on React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui.
Access: Start from a shadcn/ui project, then npx shadcn@latest add deeplethe/solid-glass/solid-glass and import the stylesheet after Tailwind and shadcn. Extra components such as status-glyph install the same way. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Product Launch Motion | Skills and learning
https://github.com/AbubakrChan/product-launch-motion
A Claude Code skill that reads a website URL and renders a local launch film with Playwright, FFmpeg and music-timed springs.
For: People who want a product launch video directed from their site inside Claude Code.
Access: npx skills add AbubakrChan/product-launch-motion. Needs Claude Code, Node 20 or later, Playwright, FFmpeg, and Python with numpy. Renders on the local machine. MIT on the skill and references. The sample films belong to Cheerful, and the MIT licence doesn't cover them.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

jev-seo | Skills and learning
https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/jev-seo
A local Python CLI and Claude Code skill that crawls a site, scores technical rules, optionally has the Jev model from TypeSafe judge each page, and writes a PDF, Excel tracker and Markdown from one audit record.
For: People who want a live site audit with ranked, evidence-linked fixes from a homepage URL.
Access: Python 3.10 or later. git clone, then python3 -m venv and pip install -r requirements.txt. WeasyPrint needs Pango. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY in .env for Jev judgments; without it the audit still runs as a partial audit. Optional PAGESPEED_API_KEY, and for --full DATAFORSEO_USERNAME and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD. Optional Playwright Chromium for JavaScript-only pages. Reports land under jev-seo-reports/. Claude Code: ln -s the clone into ~/.claude/skills/jev-seo. MIT. Bundled fonts are SIL. Jev citability answers are model judgments of a page.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

SEOmator SEO Audit | Skills and learning
https://github.com/seo-skills/seo-audit-skill
A local CLI, Electron app and Claude Code skill that crawls a site, scores technical, content and AI-crawler checks, and writes console, JSON, HTML, Markdown or LLM XML reports.
For: People who want a local site audit they can run from a terminal, a desktop window or Claude Code.
Access: Node.js 20.3 or later. npm install -g @seomator/seo-audit, then seomator audit URL. For Core Web Vitals, npx playwright install chromium. Audits land in ~/.seomator by default; seomator serve binds loopback with a per-launch token. Claude Code: npx skills add seo-skills/seo-audit-skill. MIT. This entry covers the open-source audit engine only.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Hallmark | Skills and learning
https://www.usehallmark.com/
A design skill that picks a theme, builds a self-contained HTML page from your brief, and lints it in a browser for contrast, layout and common machine-made tells.
For: People who want a coding agent to design a page with a named theme and a local lint pass.
Access: npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g. Needs Node 18 or later. Browser checks need puppeteer-core and Chrome; static checks still run without them. MIT. Bundled photo index points at Wikimedia Commons; each photograph keeps its own licence and is credited on the page.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Superpowers | Skills and learning
https://github.com/obra/superpowers
A skills pack that makes a coding agent specify, plan, test and review before it writes code.
For: People who want a spec-plan-TDD workflow in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents.
Access: Claude Code: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official. Other harnesses have their own plugin install in the README. Optional visual companion loads a logo from primeradiant.com with the Superpowers version; set SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY to turn that off. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Spec Kit | Skills and learning
https://github.github.io/spec-kit/
A GitHub toolkit that gives a coding agent spec-driven build, bug-fix and idea-assessment processes, plus templates you can replace with your own.
For: People who want a coding agent to work from a written spec, a bug report, or an idea assessment rather than jumping straight to code.
Access: Python 3.11 or later and uv. uv tool install specify-cli, then specify init my-project --integration copilot (or another listed agent). Bug-fix and assessment extensions are specify extension add bug and specify extension add assess. Community catalog listings are unvetted. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28
